headers.Content-Type: application/json for export/import execution/delete actions; multipart/form-data for import inspection

data.lang: optional language code for language/page exports
data.route: required for page export; public route path such as /about
data.release_id: optional previous release id for rerun
data.output: optional safe server output path under storage/exports/static/
data.zip: optional boolean; generate static-export.zip when true
data.import_token: required opaque one-time staging token for execution

multipart.archive: required ZIP file containing Editorial Package 1.0

last_export.output_path: server path of the static public directory

links.zip: admin API URL to ZIP when generated
links.static_zip: admin API URL to the static ZIP when generated
links.editorial_zip: admin API URL to the validated Editorial Package ZIP when generated

last_export.artifacts: static and editorial artifact descriptors with sha256 and size

data.history: filesystem-backed releases; file links and server paths omitted for read-only users
data.actions: empty for read-only users; static export actions for write/manage users
data.release: manifest/report/ZIP payload for release-specific GET endpoints when applicable
data.message: human-readable result message for POST/DELETE actions
data.capabilities: read_history, write, manage and import_available flags
data.plan: read-only editorial import plan: contents, blueprints, media, route conflicts, unresolved relations, supported modes and blocking errors
data.import_history: filesystem-backed import summaries visible to read/write/manage; sensitive details and deletion reserved to manage

response.import_execution: transactional create/upsert/replace report: create adds missing only, upsert adds missing and updates existing, replace updates existing only; filesystem history and no sync mode
